raw_log_policy: .gitattributes exempts captured continuation logs from whitespace lint and EOL conversion; source, tests and prose remain checked.

codebase_memory.scope_policy: Index and detect_changes assist inspection; git diff defines submission scope and actual tests establish correctness. MCP cache/diagnostic outputs excluded.

prose_scan.protected_spans: fenced commands, inline code, URLs and filenames unchanged
prose_scan.fact_review: Official scores/native validity/termination/cost/held-out scope checked separately; no added causal attribution.
